notes.title: Bug Fixes & Improvements v2024.48.6 - New Language Translations!
notes.notes:
Hello, flower enthusiasts! 🌸

We’re excited to share with you the latest updates we've implemented to enhance your gameplay experience. Here's what we've improved and fixed:

[h3]New Language Translations[/h3]
We’ve introduced support for 14 new languages, making the game more accessible for players around the world.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45032305/5dd9422a380c71f5b41a75ebf34c5482e83d7fa4.png[/img]

[h3]FOV Settings Expanded[/h3]
We’ve extended the Field of View (FOV) range, allowing adjustments up to 120, giving you more control over your gameplay visuals.

[h3]🛠️ Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*][b] NPC Customer Issue Resolved[/b]: Fixed the bug where NPC customers would not appear.
[*][b] Flower Pot Disappearance Issue Fixed[/b]: Addressed the issue where flower pots would vanish from venues during the venue decoration missions.
[/list]
We appreciate all the feedback and bug reports from our dedicated players. Your input helps us improve the game with every update. Please continue sharing your thoughts, and as always, happy arranging! 💐

Cheers!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2967450/Florist_Business_Simulator/

notes.title: Just a Few Hours Away: Florist Business Simulator Release
notes.notes:
Hello, flower enthusiasts! 🌸

We’re thrilled to announce that Florist Business Simulator will launch in just a few hours—[b]October 23rd, 2024, at 9 AM PST[/b]! This release marks a big step for us, and we’re excited to have you join us on this journey. 

Thank you for your support—don’t forget to wishlist the game on Steam, and we’ll see you soon in the world of floristry! 🌸

If you have any questions about the features discussed or anything related to the game, feel free to leave a comment or post on our discussion forum. Your feedback and inquiries are highly valuable to us!

Cheers!
